slow-unbox.label: Slow unbox

slow-unbox.camera: slow dolly in for the whole clip.
slow-unbox.sound: the lid sliding off the cardboard, over room tone.
beats: the closed box, with a hand resting on the lid.
the lid lifts straight up and out of frame.
light falls across {product} inside the box.

gift-reveal.label: Gift reveal
gift-reveal.shot: close-up on a wrapped present on a table.
gift-reveal.camera: static for 0–6 s, then a slow dolly in for 6–10 s.
beats: {product} sits revealed in the open paper.

first-look.label: First look
first-look.shot: medium shot at a table, {person} holding the unopened box toward the lens.
first-look.sound: cardboard and room tone, with no speech.
beats: {person} looks from the box to the lens.
lifts {product} and turns the label to the camera.

stair-unbox.label: Loft stair unbox
stair-unbox.shot: {person} sitting on an open-tread loft staircase, a shipping box on their knees.
beats: {person} sits with the box on their knees, the lid half open.
lifts {product} and turns it once in the window light.

doorstep-delivery.label: Doorstep delivery
doorstep-delivery.shot: top-down on a parcel on a doormat.
doorstep-delivery.camera: handheld, following the hands a moment late.
beats: the parcel on the mat; hands enter with a key.

pour-shot.label: Pour proof
pour-shot.camera: slow dolly in toward the bowl for the whole clip, with no zoom and no focus change.
pour-shot.subject: {product}, held in one right hand above a white ceramic bowl.
pour-shot.sound: the soft sound of the pour.
pour-shot.avoid: a second bottle; a second hand.
beats: the hand lifts {product} into frame from the right edge.
the hand tilts it, and one steady stream pours into the bowl.
the pour stops, and the hand turns the label square to the camera.
the hand holds still while the surface in the bowl settles.

market-stroll.label: Market stroll
market-stroll.shot: medium shot at eye level in a market aisle.
market-stroll.camera: truck right at walking pace for the whole clip.
market-stroll.avoid: other brands' labels readable on the stalls.
beats: {person} walks into frame along the stalls.
turns the label to the camera.
holds it still at chest height.

hand-turn.label: Hand turn 360
hand-turn.shot: medium close-up at eye level against a clean background.
hand-turn.avoid: a full spin; text on the back that is not in the reference photos.
beats: the hand holds {product} with the front to the camera.
a half-turn shows the side and the back.
it turns back to the front and stays still.

morning-ritual.label: Morning ritual
morning-ritual.shot: medium close-up on the counter in morning light.
morning-ritual.sound: a kettle or a tap, and birds outside.
beats: morning light on the counter; a hand reaches in.
the hand sets it down, label out.

bag-check.label: Bag check
bag-check.shot: medium close-up, an open bag held toward the lens.
beats: the bag opens toward the lens.
holds it up to the camera.
a small tilt, so the label catches the light.

close-detail.label: Close to the lens
close-detail.camera: a focus pull for 0–2 s, a dolly out for 2–6 s, then static for 6–10 s.
beats: {product} fills the frame, soft, and the focus lands on the label.
the camera dollies out to show all of it.
the hand turns it so the light rakes across the texture.
{person} walks the trail and holds {product} up beside their face.
the view, with {product} in hand in the foreground.

street-carry.label: Street carry
street-carry.shot: medium shot, {person} walking down a city street.
street-carry.camera: dolly out at walking pace for 0–6 s, then static for 6–10 s.
beats: {person} walks toward the lens, {product} carried in view.

flat-lay.label: Flat lay
flat-lay.sound: soft taps as each item lands.
beats: an empty surface; the first items are placed.
more items, one at a time.

reaction-reveal.label: Reaction + reveal
reaction-reveal.composer: a hard cut at 4 s; the hook over shot 1 and the call to action over shot 3.

beats: {person} glances up, eyebrows raised, eyes on something just out of frame.
{product}, with light gliding across the label.

mirror-try-on.label: Mirror try-on
mirror-try-on.shot: medium shot, {person} facing a mirror, the reflection visible.
mirror-try-on.avoid: the reflection not matching the person.
beats: {person} faces the mirror with {product} in hand.

before-after.label: Old way, new way
before-after.avoid: different hands or a different light in the two halves.

beats: the hands do the task the usual way, slowly and awkwardly: {problem}.
the same hands do the same task with {product}, quickly and cleanly.

get-ready.label: Get ready with me
get-ready.shot: medium close-up at a vanity, as a front camera sees it.
get-ready.avoid: make-up appearing before it is applied.
beats: {person} waves at the lens, without speaking.
turns to show the final look.

seaside-wear.label: Seaside wear
seaside-wear.shot: medium shot on a terrace above the sea.
seaside-wear.camera: a slow arc, a quarter turn around {person}.
seaside-wear.light: golden hour cinematography, with warm flare from the low sun.

beach-day.label: Beach day
beach-day.shot: overhead, {person} lying on a beach towel.
beats: turns to the lens and laughs.

swatch-test.label: Swatch test
swatch-test.shot: close-up of a forearm on a white surface.
swatch-test.avoid: a shade different from the product's own.
swatch-test.composer: drops the frame rate to 12 fps for the stop-motion feel.
beats: a clean arm, with {product} just above it.
{product} swipes across the skin, and a swatch appears.
{product} is set down beside the swatch.

floor-read.label: Floor break
floor-read.shot: floor level, low angle, {person} lying on a patterned rug.

desk-break.label: Desk break
desk-break.shot: medium shot at eye level, like a laptop camera on the desk.
desk-break.camera: static, locked off, with no movement, no zoom and no focus change.
desk-break.sound: quiet room tone and keyboard taps.
beats: {person} types on the laptop, then glances at the camera.
pushes the laptop aside with one hand and picks up {product}.
holds {product} up to the lens, label facing the camera, and smiles.

macro-sizzle.label: Macro sizzle
macro-sizzle.shot: macro tabletop, {product} on a rustic board.
macro-sizzle.sound: the crack and crumbs falling on wood.
beats: hands break it open, and crumbs fall.

tap-through.label: Tap-through
tap-through.shot: a hand holding a phone toward the camera.
beats: the phone in hand, screen to the lens.
the phone tilts slightly toward the lens.

feature-in-15.label: Feature in 15
feature-in-15.camera: static for 0–6 s, then a slow dolly in for 6–10 s.
beats: the hand lifts the phone into frame.
the hand brings the phone closer.
the second screenshot, with "Done in seconds".

gate-app.label: On the go app
gate-app.shot: a hand holding a phone up on the move, the street soft behind.
beats: a glance down at the screen.

gym-tablet.label: Gym tablet
gym-tablet.shot: a tablet held up in a bright gym.
gym-tablet.sound: gym echo and a distant weight clank.
beats: the tablet tilts toward the lens.
{person} looks at the phone, eyebrows up, with a half laugh of disbelief.

room-reveal.label: Room reveal
room-reveal.shot: a wide shot of a styled room in soft daylight.
room-reveal.camera: a slow pan right for 0–7 s, then static on {product} for 7–10 s.
room-reveal.avoid: people; anything in the room moving.

beats: {product} on its shelf, with light shifting slowly across it.

made-by-hand.label: Made by hand
made-by-hand.shot: close-up on a workbench in a small workshop, in window light.
made-by-hand.camera: static for 0–3 s, a slow dolly in for 3–7 s, then a rack focus for 7–10 s.
beats: the workshop, its tools and the light.
the hands give {product} its finishing touch.
the focus moves to the finished piece on the bench.

packing-order.label: Packing your order
beats: the order slip on the table.
place it in the box with the note.

liquid-splash.label: Liquid splash
liquid-splash.shot: medium close-up, {product} standing alone, lit as a hero.
liquid-splash.lands: the hero still, with droplets suspended.
beats: a splash of liquid rises around it in slow motion.
the droplets hang still around it.

levitate.label: Levitate
levitate.shot: medium shot, a plinth under soft rim light.
levitate.lands: the hero still on the plinth.
levitate.sound: a soft air hum, then a light touch-down.
beats: {product} floats in the air, turning slowly.
it comes to rest on the plinth.

hero-orbit.label: Hero orbit
hero-orbit.shot: {product} alone on a round plinth against a seamless colour backdrop.
hero-orbit.avoid: the product moving; only the camera moves.

beats: {product} drops into frame and settles on the surface.
{product} drops into frame and lands; the hook card sits over it.
one slow band of light passes across {product}.
{product} holds still under the call to action.

black-friday.label: Black Friday
black-friday.light: chiaroscuro lighting on a low-key set.

beats: {product} drops into a pool of hard light on a black set and settles.

summer-sale.label: Summer offer
summer-sale.sound: a light breeze and distant cicadas.

beats: leaf shadows drift across {product} in hard sun.

ramadan-offer.label: Ramadan offer
ramadan-offer.light: blue hour with warm practical lights.

beats: behind {product}, warm lantern lights glow on one after another at blue hour.

eid-offer.label: Eid offer
eid-offer.light: blue hour with warm practical lights.
eid-offer.sound: a festive murmur in the distance.

beats: behind {product}, string lights glow on and gently twinkle.
a hand sets {product} on a desk among notebooks and pencils.
a soft band of light passes across {product} from left to right.
a soft shadow drifts slowly across the surface beside {product}.
all of them, still, under the call to action.
every photo at once, with the hook.
one slow band of light passes across {product}.
one slow band of light passes across {product}.
one slow band of light passes across {product}.

chat-reveal.label: Chat reveal
chat-reveal.sound: a message pop on each bubble, added by the composer.

beats: the question and the answer as chat bubbles.
one slow band of light passes across {product}.

founder-story.label: Founder story
founder-story.attitude: proud and plain, like telling a friend why they started.
beats: {person} looks up from {product} to the lens and says: "{hook}"

three-reasons.label: 3 reasons
three-reasons.attitude: sure of it, slightly amused that people still ask.

myth-vs-fact.label: Myth vs fact (hidden)
myth-vs-fact.attitude: patient, about to clear something up.
beats: {person} shakes their head slightly and says: "{hook}"

quick-tip.label: Quick tip (hidden)
quick-tip.attitude: helpful, letting the viewer in on a trick.
beats: shows the tip with {product}, using both hands.

customer-letter.label: Customer letter (hidden)
customer-letter.composer: the question shown as a card over 0–4 s.
beats: {person} reads the question from a phone, then looks up.

expert-take.label: Expert take (hidden)
expert-take.attitude: calm authority; they do this every day.
beats: {person} looks up from their work and says: "{hook}"
says what works, with {product} in hand.

investigation.label: I looked into it (hidden)
investigation.attitude: curious and a little sceptical, then convinced.

beats: the finding: {product}'s label, close, in {person}'s hand.

underdog.label: Underdog story (hidden)
underdog.attitude: quietly determined, a small team against big brands.
beats: rests a hand on {product} and says: "{body}"

green-screen.label: Green-screen take (hidden)
green-screen.background: the product's photo, placed behind the person by the composer. The model renders the person alone, against a plain backdrop.
beats: {person} points up and behind and says: "{hook}"
gives the proof in one line.

comment-reply.label: Reply to a comment
comment-reply.attitude: relaxed and honest, answering a friend.
beats: {person} looks at the phone, reading the comment.

problem-to-app.label: Problem → app (hidden)
problem-to-app.attitude: fed up with the old way, relieved by the new one.
beats: holds up the phone and says: "{body}"
turns the phone's screen to the lens; the screen is added by the composer.

street-question.label: Street question (hidden)
street-question.attitude: caught off guard, then genuinely keen.
street-question.composer: the question as a caption over shot 1, and a punch-in on {product} at the end.

beats: a handheld microphone moves toward {person}, who holds {product}.
{product} on the side table, with no speech.

shots.camera: static, from the dashboard on the driver

beats: the passenger glances at {product} and lifts it.
shots.camera: static, from the dashboard on the passenger

ingredient-orbit.label: Ingredients around it
ingredient-orbit.shot: medium close-up, {product} centred on a low plinth.
ingredient-orbit.subject: {product}, plus three ingredients from its identity card: {ingredient_1}, {ingredient_2} and {ingredient_3}.
ingredient-orbit.lands: the approved still with the ingredients around the base.
ingredient-orbit.sound: a soft air whoosh as each ingredient passes, over studio room tone.
ingredient-orbit.avoid: any ingredient that is not on the identity card; any ingredient covering the label.
ingredient-orbit.shown_when: the identity card lists at least three ingredients.
beats: the three ingredients drift in from the edges and circle it slowly.
they settle around its base, and nothing moves.

exploded-view.label: Every part
exploded-view.shot: medium shot, {product} centred against a plain backdrop.
exploded-view.subject: {product}, made of the parts listed on its identity card: {parts}.
exploded-view.lands: the whole product, exactly as in the first frame.
exploded-view.sound: soft mechanical slides, and a click as it closes.
exploded-view.avoid: parts that are not on the identity card; parts changing shape; movement on more than one axis.
exploded-view.shown_when: the product is physical and its card lists its parts. It is hidden for food and services.
beats: its parts slide apart along one vertical axis, evenly spaced.
they slide back together and close with a click.

light-sweep.label: Light reveal
light-sweep.shot: medium close-up from a low angle, against a dark seamless backdrop.
light-sweep.light: chiaroscuro lighting; one soft strip light moves across the set.
light-sweep.lands: the approved hero still, fully lit.
light-sweep.sound: a soft airy whoosh that follows the sweep.
light-sweep.avoid: the label unreadable in the last 3 s; lens flare across the label.
beats: near darkness; a rim light traces the edge of {product}.
a soft band of light sweeps across {product} from left to right.

freeze-moment.label: Frozen splash
freeze-moment.camera: a slow 90° arc to the right around {product}, for the whole clip.
freeze-moment.subject: {product} inside a frozen burst of {material}: water for drinks and skincare, powder for cosmetics, crumbs for food.
freeze-moment.lands: the approved hero still, with the label square to the camera.
freeze-moment.sound: near silence, with a faint airy hush.
freeze-moment.avoid: droplets moving or falling; the product rotating (only the camera moves).
beats: the camera starts on the side of {product}; every droplet hangs still.
the camera travels around it; time stays frozen.
the camera stops square on the label.

colour-morph.label: Every colour
colour-morph.shot: medium close-up against a neutral grey backdrop.
colour-morph.subject: {product} in {variant_a} at the start and in {variant_b} at the end.
colour-morph.frames: the first frame is a real photo of variant A and the last frame is a real photo of variant B, taken from the same angle in the same light.
colour-morph.avoid: the shape changing during the wipe; any colour that is not in the two photos.
colour-morph.shown_when: the product has two variant photos taken from the same angle.
beats: one smooth colour wipe passes over {product} from top to bottom.

scale-check.label: Real size
scale-check.shot: medium close-up at eye level on a counter.
scale-check.subject: {product}, with a plain white coffee mug beside it for scale.
scale-check.sound: room tone, and a soft knock as it is lifted.
scale-check.avoid: the product changing size between beats; an oversized mug.
beats: the hand holds it still beside the mug.

problem-fix.label: Problem, then fixed
problem-fix.sound: room tone, a small clatter in shot 1, and a clean click in shot 2.
problem-fix.avoid: an exaggerated mess; a face showing disgust.
problem-fix.composer: a hard cut at 4 s, and the caption {hook} over shot 1.

beats: the problem in plain view: {problem}, taken from the brief's buyer situation and top objection (S17-34).
the hands try the usual way and give up.
the result, still, with the label to the camera.

three-steps.label: How to, in 3 steps
three-steps.sound: the sounds of each step, close.
three-steps.avoid: the hands changing between shots (same sleeves, same rings); the surface changing.
three-steps.composer: a number (1, 2, 3) in the corner of each shot, and a cut on each step.

beats: the hands do step 3, and the result is visible: {step_3}.

satisfying.label: Oddly satisfying
satisfying.lands: the first frame, so the clip loops without a seam.
satisfying.sound: the sound of the action, close and crisp.
satisfying.avoid: a second action; any part breaking.
beats: one tactile action, done slowly and once: {action} (a click, a peel, a snap, a scoop or a twist).
everything returns to exactly how it started.

texture-sound.label: Sound on
texture-sound.shot: macro, very close, with the plane of focus on the texture.
texture-sound.camera: slow dolly in for the whole clip.
texture-sound.sound: the scoop, crunch or fizz, recorded close and loud over silence. This is the one scene where the model's sound leads: the composer leaves the music bed off or lowers it well under.
texture-sound.avoid: liquid or crumbs moving with no visible cause.
beats: a spoon or a fingertip moves toward the texture of {product}.
it scoops, crunches or fizzes, close and loud.
it pulls away and the texture settles.

put-to-test.label: Put to the test
put-to-test.shown_when: the brand has approved the test as a claim (S17-36). Without an approved claim, the scene is hidden for that product.
put-to-test.sound: the sound of the test, then quiet.
put-to-test.avoid: any damage shown; a result more dramatic than the claim; numbers on screen.

beats: the test: {test} (for example water poured over it, a drop onto a cushion, or a stretch).

cook-with-it.label: Cook with it
cook-with-it.sound: a knife on the board, a sizzle, and a clink at the end.
cook-with-it.avoid: the label covered; ingredients the brand forbids.

beats: {product} is poured or sprinkled into the pan or bowl, label to the camera.
the finished dish, with steam rising.

pov-use.label: POV
pov-use.shot: first-person view from eye height, with the forearms in frame.
pov-use.camera: handheld at eye height, following the hands.
pov-use.sound: the place's room tone and the sounds of use.
pov-use.avoid: any face or body other than the forearms; a third hand.
beats: the hands lift it toward the eyes, label out.

showing-a-friend.label: Showing a friend
showing-a-friend.shot: a medium two-shot at a table, at eye level.
showing-a-friend.subject: {person_a} and {person_b}, each with their lock sentence word for word.
showing-a-friend.sound: room tone and a short laugh, with no words.
showing-a-friend.avoid: the two faces or outfits swapping; a third person.
beats: both look at it and laugh.

a-day-with-it.label: A day with it
a-day-with-it.avoid: the person's face or clothes changing between shots; the product changing between shots.

beats: morning: {person} picks up {product} from the bedside table.
the commute: {person} walks with {product} in hand.
at work: {person} uses {product} at the desk.
evening: {person} sets {product} down at home, label out.

fit-check.label: Fit check
fit-check.shot: a full-length mirror selfie, the phone at chest height.
fit-check.camera: static; the mirror shows the shot.
fit-check.sound: room tone and the rustle of fabric.
fit-check.avoid: the reflection not matching; the phone covering the product; the clothes changing.

outfit-switch.label: Outfit switch
outfit-switch.frames: the first frame is the avatar in outfit A and the last frame is the avatar in outfit B wearing the product, both approved stills.
outfit-switch.avoid: the face or body changing through the spin.

shared-table.label: Shared table
shared-table.camera: truck right along the table at walking pace, for the whole clip.
shared-table.sound: a murmur of voices with no clear words, cutlery, and a clink of glasses at the end.
shared-table.avoid: more people than the cast; faces swapping.
beats: the table with plates and glasses, and the people talking.

packed-for-trip.label: Packed for the trip
packed-for-trip.shot: top-down on an open bag on a bed.
packed-for-trip.lands: the approved still of the bag with {product} on top.
beats: the hands pack folded clothes and travel things.
{product} goes in last, on top, label up.
the hands pull the zip half closed, with {product} still in view.

night-out.label: Night out
night-out.shot: medium close-up, on a street at night.
night-out.light: neon gel lighting, magenta and teal, with reflections on wet pavement.
night-out.sound: the street at night, distant traffic and footsteps.
night-out.avoid: readable signs; sharp faces in the crowd.
beats: {person} walks into the light under a neon sign.
{person} looks at the lens with a half smile.

every-season.label: Every season
every-season.shot: medium close-up, {product} centred on the same surface throughout.
every-season.frames: the first frame is the product in the summer set and the last frame is the product in the winter set, both approved stills from the same angle.
every-season.avoid: the product moving or changing in any way.
beats: the set changes around it: the light cools, leaves turn, and snow begins to fall outside the window.
the same {product} in a winter setting.

launch-tease.label: Coming soon
launch-tease.shot: medium close-up against a dark backdrop.
launch-tease.avoid: the shape under the cloth not matching the product's silhouette.
beats: a silhouette under a dark cloth, lit from behind.
the cloth slides off to the left.

bundle-build.label: Build the bundle
bundle-build.shot: top-down on an open gift box.
bundle-build.subject: {product_1}, {product_2} and {product_3}, the products in the bundle (S17-21).
bundle-build.lands: the approved still of the full box.
bundle-build.sound: a soft drop for each product.
bundle-build.avoid: products changing size; products that are not in the bundle.
beats: the products drop in, one at a time.
a hand lays a ribbon across the top, and the products stay in view.

service-result.label: The result
service-result.frames: the first and last frames are the brand's own real before and after photos, from its place photos (S17-28). They are never invented.
service-result.shot: the same angle as the two photos.
service-result.avoid: a result better than the after photo; customers' faces.
service-result.shown_when: the brand has uploaded a before and after pair.

kitchen-pass.label: From our kitchen

kitchen-pass.shown_when: the business is a restaurant or a food service.
beats: the chef's hands plate {product}, the dish.
a final touch: sauce, herbs or zest.
the plate slides onto the pass under the heat lamp.

our-team.label: Our team at work
our-team.people: hands and backs only. Faces appear only with `real_avatars` consent (S17-13, Scale).

the finished work, or {product} on the counter.
